name: OTA_testcases_2
context:
I am validating OTA feature.
Context:
Tapping Reload now loads the app, and navigates to Homepage
Tapping MaybeLater, closes the Update Ready sheet
Tapping MaybeLater, then put the app in background, then come back to the app, Update Ready sheet shows up
Tapping anywhere above the Update Ready bottom sheet, closes the sheet
Killing the app with sheet ON, and then the app opened, updates applied automatically.
Interacting with Update ready sheet 'Reload Now' button will always navigate back to HomePage
Turning off INternet, and then tap "reload now' button, skeleton loads. Then when internt is resumed back, then the content should load if user is on any page, such as Home, Food, Health, Login page etc

Update Ready shouldnt come when there are no actual updates

cases.objective: Verify that tapping Reload Now applies the update and navigates the user to the Homepage
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: App reloads, update is applied, and user is navigated to the Homepage

cases.title: Tap Reload Now navigates to Homepage

cases.objective: Verify that tapping Maybe Later dismisses the Update Ready bottom sheet without reloading
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Update Ready sheet is dismissed and the Recipes screen remains fully accessible

cases.title: Tap Maybe Later closes the Update Ready sheet

cases.objective: Verify that after dismissing with Maybe Later, the Update Ready sheet re-appears when the app is brought back from background
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Update Ready sheet is dismissed
App moves to background
steps.step: Press the device Home button to send the app to the background

steps.expected_result: Update Ready bottom sheet appears again on the current screen
steps.step: Tap the app icon to bring it back to the foreground

cases.title: Maybe Later then background then foreground shows sheet again

cases.objective: Verify that tapping anywhere on the dimmed backdrop above the Update Ready sheet dismisses it
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Update Ready sheet is dismissed and the Recipes screen is fully interactive
steps.step: Tap on the dimmed Recipes screen area above the Update Ready bottom sheet

cases.title: Tap dimmed area above sheet closes it

cases.objective: Verify that force-killing the app while the Update Ready sheet is open causes the update to be applied automatically on next launch
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: App is terminated
steps.step: Force-kill the app via the app switcher while the sheet is showing

steps.expected_result: App launches with the update already applied automatically, no Update Ready sheet shown
steps.step: Relaunch the app by tapping its icon

cases.title: Kill app with sheet open then reopen applies update automatically

cases.objective: Verify that Reload Now always redirects to Homepage regardless of the screen where the sheet appeared
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen (not the Homepage) and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Recipes screen with Update Ready sheet is displayed
steps.step: Confirm current screen is Recipes, not Homepage

steps.expected_result: App reloads and navigates to the Homepage, not back to Recipes

cases.title: Reload Now from non-Home screen still navigates to Homepage

cases.objective: Verify that tapping Reload Now without internet shows a skeleton loading state
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen, Update Ready sheet is visible, and device internet is turned off

steps.expected_result: Internet is disabled
App attempts to reload and displays skeleton loader UI instead of content

cases.title: Reload Now with internet off shows skeleton loader

cases.objective: Verify that content loads correctly once internet is restored after tapping Reload Now with no connectivity
cases.precondition: User tapped Reload Now with internet off and skeleton loader is showing on a page (e.g. Home, Food, Health)

steps.expected_result: Skeleton loader is displayed
steps.step: Turn off internet and tap 'Reload Now' to trigger skeleton state

steps.expected_result: Content loads and replaces the skeleton loader on the current page

cases.title: Internet restored after Reload Now loads content

cases.objective: Verify whether the Update Ready sheet can be dismissed by swiping it downward
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Sheet either stays open or closes gracefully; update is not lost
steps.step: Swipe down on the Update Ready bottom sheet

cases.title: Sheet cannot be swiped down to dismiss

cases.objective: Verify that UI elements on the Recipes screen (e.g. search, recipe items) are not interactable while the sheet is open
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: No interaction occurs on the underlying screen; sheet remains in focus
steps.step: Tap on the Search bar or a recipe item visible behind the sheet

cases.title: Update Ready sheet blocks interaction with underlying screen

cases.objective: Verify that after dismissing the sheet multiple times with Maybe Later, eventually tapping Reload Now still navigates to Homepage
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Sheet dismisses
Sheet re-appears and is dismissed each time
steps.step: Background and foreground the app twice to trigger the sheet again each time and tap 'Maybe Later' each time

steps.expected_result: App reloads and navigates to Homepage successfully
steps.step: Background and foreground the app once more, then tap 'Reload Now'

cases.title: Multiple Maybe Later taps then Reload Now navigates to Homepage

cases.objective: Verify that Reload Now from the Login page context still navigates to the Homepage after update
cases.precondition: User is on the Login page and the Update Ready bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Update Ready sheet visible on Login page
steps.step: Confirm the Update Ready sheet is displayed over the Login page

steps.expected_result: App reloads, update is applied, and user lands on the Homepage

cases.title: Reload Now on Login page navigates to Homepage

cases.objective: Verify the Update Ready sheet is not shown when there is no new OTA update pending
cases.precondition: App is on the latest version with no pending OTA update; user is on the Recipes screen

steps.expected_result: Recipes screen loads normally with no Update Ready bottom sheet visible
steps.step: Open the app and navigate to the Recipes screen

cases.title: Update Ready sheet does not appear when no update is available

cases.objective: Verify tapping Reload Now while on the Recipes screen lands the user on the Homepage after update
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready sheet is displayed

steps.expected_result: Sheet shows 'Reload Now' button and 'Maybe Later' link
steps.step: Observe the Update Ready bottom sheet on the Recipes screen

steps.expected_result: App reloads and navigates to the Homepage, not the Recipes screen

cases.title: Reload Now on Recipes screen navigates to Homepage

cases.objective: Verify that choosing Maybe Later then force-closing and reopening the app still presents the Update Ready sheet (update not yet applied)
cases.precondition: Update Ready sheet is visible; user is on the Recipes screen

steps.expected_result: Update Ready sheet closes; user remains on Recipes screen
App is fully closed
steps.step: Force-kill the app from the app switcher

steps.expected_result: App opens and the Update Ready sheet appears again since update was not applied

cases.title: Maybe Later then kill app then reopen shows Update Ready sheet again

cases.objective: Verify the Update Ready sheet consistently reappears each time the app returns to foreground after Maybe Later is chosen
cases.precondition: Update Ready sheet is visible; user is on the Recipes screen

steps.expected_result: Sheet closes
App is backgrounded
Update Ready sheet appears again
Sheet closes
Update Ready sheet appears again for the second time
steps.step: Send app to background and bring to foreground a second time

cases.title: Sheet reappears on every foreground resume after Maybe Later

cases.objective: Verify skeleton loader shows on Recipes screen when internet is off at Reload Now, then content loads once connection is restored
cases.precondition: User is on Recipes screen with Update Ready sheet visible; device internet is turned off

steps.expected_result: Device has no internet connectivity
steps.step: Confirm internet is disabled on the device

steps.expected_result: App reloads and shows skeleton loader (no actual content)
Recipes screen content loads and populates replacing the skeleton loader

cases.title: Reload Now with internet off on Recipes screen then internet restored loads content

cases.objective: Verify that UI elements behind the Update Ready sheet (e.g., info icon) are not interactive while the sheet is displayed
cases.precondition: User is on Recipes screen and Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Nothing happens or the sheet closes (no info dialog opens), confirming underlying UI is blocked
steps.step: Attempt to tap the info icon (ⓘ) next to 'Recipe Book' visible behind the sheet

cases.title: Tapping info icon while Update Ready sheet is visible

cases.objective: Verify all expected text and buttons on the Update Ready sheet are displayed correctly
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Sheet shows title 'Update Ready', descriptive message about new version, 'Reload Now' button, and 'Maybe Later' link all fully visible without truncation
steps.step: Observe the Update Ready bottom sheet

cases.title: Update Ready sheet content is fully visible and readable

cases.objective: Verify that after tapping Reload Now and the app updates, the Update Ready sheet does not appear again on subsequent foreground resume
cases.precondition: User is on the Recipes screen and the Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: App reloads and navigates to Homepage
App is backgrounded
Update Ready sheet does NOT appear since the update has already been applied

cases.title: Reload Now triggers update only once and sheet does not reappear after reload

cases.objective: Verify the search bar on the Recipes screen is not accessible while the Update Ready sheet is displayed
cases.precondition: User is on Recipes screen and Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Keyboard does not appear and search bar is not focused, confirming interaction is blocked by the sheet
steps.step: Attempt to tap the Search bar visible behind the Update Ready sheet

cases.title: Search bar interaction blocked by Update Ready sheet

cases.objective: Verify that tapping Maybe Later does not trigger any update or reload, leaving the current screen state intact
cases.precondition: User is on Recipes screen with recently generated recipes visible and Update Ready sheet displayed

steps.expected_result: Recipes such as 'Coconut Flour Crepes' and 'Savory Sweet Potato Hash' are visible
steps.step: Note the recipes listed under 'Recently Generated' before interacting with the sheet

steps.expected_result: Sheet closes and the same recipes are still displayed unchanged; no reload occurs

cases.title: Maybe Later does not apply the update — content unchanged after dismissal
